subject.title: memory_search: chokidar file watcher silently stops delivering events, index goes stale

question: Should OpenClaw make periodic memory sync fallback default-on for unconfigured memorySearch to protect against silent watcher misses, or keep interval sync opt-in and rely on docs/doctor/operator guidance?
rationale: The source-level bug is clear, but the likely fix changes default background sync behavior for existing users and the repository policy treats fallback/default changes as compatibility-sensitive.

options.title: Approve default-on fallback
options.body: Accept the 30-minute default or another chosen interval, preserve explicit 0 opt-out, and require upgrade/fresh-install proof plus scoped dirty-rescan tests before merge.

options.title: Keep interval opt-in
options.body: Reject the default change and instead document or surface intervalMinutes as the supported workaround for operators who need watcher-failure resilience.

options.title: Request adaptive health check
options.body: Keep the default at 0 but require a watcher-health or doctor-driven repair path that warns and suggests enabling interval sync after evidence of missed events.

recommendation.title: Approve default-on fallback
recommendation.body: Accept the 30-minute default or another chosen interval, preserve explicit 0 opt-out, and require upgrade/fresh-install proof plus scoped dirty-rescan tests before merge.
